SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.atkBlkCx.conten: Each strike-mode row has clickable Atk, Blk, and CX values — click them to roll an attack, a block, or a counterstrike. Try them: the roll appears in the chat log. Once this tour ends, hovering any value shows a tooltip of exactly how it was calculated — Foundry hides tooltips while a tour is running, so you won't see them right now. Remember — each of these can be rolled anytime, in or out of combat, in any order, independently of the others. Press Next.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.atkBlkCx.title: Roll It
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.bowArmRule.cont: On the Combat tab, use the Held Items dropdowns. Hold the Longbow 125 in one arm and watch: its Crush melee mode appears (you can swing a bow one-handed like a fragile club — at real risk of breaking it), but no Ranged strike mode does — a bow must be drawn with two hands. Now hold the Longbow 125 in your other arm as well (select it in both dropdowns). Its Ranged strike mode appears above. Next stays disabled until the bow is held in both arms.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.description: See how SoHL assists — but never plays — a fight: turn a weapon on the sheet into an attack roll, an impact, and a recorded injury. Assisted Combat is unopinionated — no token, no scene, no turn order — and every action (ATK, BLK, CX, Impact, Resolve Injury) is independent and runnable at any time. Uses a character you already have.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.done.content: You turned a weapon on the sheet into an attack, an impact, and a recorded injury — with no token, no scene, and no fixed order, and with the win/loss ruling left in your hands. Every step was an independent action you can use on its own. You can re-run this tour any time from Settings → Tour Management. Press the check to finish.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.done.title: A Swing Becomes a Wound
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.gear.content: On the Gear tab, use Create Gear (highlighted) to add four weapons, each via its Type and Archetype — a one-handed Broadsword, a two-handed Battlesword, a Longbow 125, and a Roundshield (all are Weapon type). Keep the suggested name and shortcode for this tour, then close each item sheet. Next stays disabled until all four exist.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.gear.title: Something to Swing
A one-handed weapon needs only one hand. Free up an arm and hold the Broadsword in it (change one Held Items dropdown to the Broadsword). Its melee strike modes appear right away. Press Next.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.impact.content: The system has produced the rolls, but it does not decide who won — that opposed outcome is yours to read off the rulebook (e.g. an attacker's moderate success versus a defender's critical failure). Standing in for that human step, we'll pretend the Broadsword hit: click the Impact value on its strike-mode row. The impact calculation appears in the chat log, derived from the roll. Computing impact is optional and just as independent. Press Next.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.impact.title: Adjudicate, Then Pretend the Hit
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.intro.content: Assisted Combat is really just an improved roll mechanic. It is unopinionated: it needs no token, no scene, and no turn order. ATK, BLK, CX, Impact, and Resolve Injury are each completely independent — roll any of them at any time, in or out of combat, in any order. Crucially, the system rolls for you but does not decide who won — after an attack and a defence, you read the result off the rulebook. This tour walks one coherent path (attack → impact → injury) on a character you already own, but none of it is a required sequence. Press Next to begin.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.intro.title: Assist, Don't Automate
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.prepare.content: This tour coaches a character you already have — it never builds one for you. If you already own a ready Being, you're set — just press Next. If not, import a ready-made one: open the Actors compendium, expand the Pregens folder, right-click Áldrik Hárvenar, and choose Import Entry (any populated Being works — a compendium character, or one built by the Character Creation tour). Next stays disabled until you own a Being.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.prepare.title: A Character to Fight With
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.resolveInjury.c: Go to the Actions tab and run the Resolve Injury action (the highlighted ▶). In its dialog, fill in the aspect and impact from the impact card in chat, leave the location on “(derive from Target ZN + ZD)” to roll a random hit location, and click OK. The wound is created and recorded on the sheet. Next stays disabled until an injury is recorded.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.standaloneInjur: An injury needs no combat at all. Say the GM tells you: “you fell 10 feet — that's blunt, impact 10.” Run Resolve Injury again, type Blunt and 10 straight in, and click OK — same dialog, same result, no roll and no impact card. Next stays disabled until a second injury is recorded.
SOHL.Tour.AssistedCombat.title: SoHL: Assisted Combat
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.archetype.content: Choose the Being type, pick the "Basic Folk (basicfolk)" archetype from the Archetype dropdown. It fills in the Name and Shortcode for you — you can rename the character now or later. Then click Create Actor to create it. Press Next once the character sheet is open.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.archetype.title: Start from Basic Folk
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.attributes.conten: On the Profile tab, edit an attribute through its ⋮ menu (highlighted). Try one, then fill in the rest — any values are fine (leaving them all at 10 works). Press Next to continue.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.attributes.title: Attributes
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.backpack.content: On the Gear tab, add a backpack. Select Create Gear, from the dropdown select Type: Container and Archetype: Backpack, then select Create Item. Close the item sheet. Notice the Backpack header that has appeared at the bottom of the gear, with "Capacity: 0/30". Next stays disabled until the backpack exists.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.backpack.title: A Place for Everything
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.combatArmor.conte: On the Combat tab, the Body Locations table now shows the tunic's armor values added to your shoulders and torso — scroll down to the Right Arm, Left Arm, and Torso, and note the values in the Blunt/Edged/Piercing/Fire rows (should be 4/8/5/5) and the Layers column should show Leather. Press Next.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.combatArmor.title: Protected
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.combatHold.conten: On the Combat tab, use the Held Items dropdowns to hold the Broadsword in your right arm and the Roundshield in your left arm. Next stays disabled until both are held in the correct arm.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.combatHold.title: Take Up Arms
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.createActor.conte: The Actors tab is open. Click the highlighted Create Actor button. Press Next once the create dialog is open.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.createActor.title: Create Your Character
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.description: Build your first character from scratch — from the Create Actor dialog to a combat-ready, equipped, armoured Being with a mystery and a packed backpack. The tour walks the whole Being sheet: Facade, Profile, Skills, Gear, Combat, Mysteries, and containers.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.done.content: That's a complete character — equipped, armoured, holding a weapon, with an Arcane Talent and a packed backpack. You can re-run this tour any time from Settings → Tour Management. Press the check to finish.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.done.title: Ready for Adventure
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.dossier.content: Still on the Profile tab, add your character's Dossier — private background notes for you and the GM. Write anything; press Next when ready.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.dossier.title: The Dossier
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.dragIn.content: Drag the Tinderbox into the Backpack (the highlighted container section). Next stays disabled until it's inside.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.dragIn.title: Pack It Away
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.dragOut.content: Now drag the Tinderbox back out onto the On Body list (highlighted). Next stays disabled until it's back on your person.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.dragOut.title: …and Back Out
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.facade.content: This is the Facade — what other players see. Click the portrait to set a profile picture, and add a public description below. Anything goes; press Next when you're done.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.facade.title: The Facade
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.gearTunic.content: Back on the Gear tab, use Create Gear to add a new Leather Tunic (select Type: Armor and Archetype: Leather Tunic) from the archetype dropdown, select Create Item, then close the sheet. Next, wear the armor by clicking the light-gray shield icon on its row (the icon should turn dark, meaning "is worn").
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.gearTunic.title: Armour Up
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.gearWeapons.conte: On the Gear tab, click Create Gear (highlighted) and from the Type field choose Weapon. Use the Archetype field to select a Broadsword and click Create Item (be sure to not change the name or shortcode for this tour). Review the entries in the sheet, then close the Weapon Item sheet. Click Create Gear, select Weapon from the Type field, and select Roundshield from the Archetype field, then click Create Item (be sure to not change the name or shortcode for this tour). Review the entries in the sheet, then close the Weapon Item sheet. Next stays disabled until both Broadsword and Roundshield exist.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.gearWeapons.title: Arm Your Character
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.mysteryAdd.conten: On the Mysteries tab, click Add Mystical Ability (highlighted), choose Subtype: Arcane Talent and Archetype: (none). Give the new Mystical Ability a name and shortcode (e.g., Telepathy and telepathy). Next stays disabled until an Arcane Talent exists.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.mysteryAdd.title: An Arcane Talent
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.mysteryEdit.conte: Open your new talent (right-click its row or use the ⋮ menu → Edit), change its Mastery Level, and close the sheet. Back here, its row shows the new ML. Press Next.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.mysteryEdit.title: Tune the Talent
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.populated.content: Your Being sheet opens already populated from Basic Folk — attributes, skills, and a body, all ready to flesh out. Next stays disabled until a Basic Folk being exists, so if you started blank, create it from the Basic Folk archetype now.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.populated.title: A Fully-Populated Sheet
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.skillsMelee.conte: On the Skills tab, open the Melee skill — right-click its row, or use the highlighted ⋮ menu, and choose Edit. Adjust its Mastery Level, then close the item sheet. Press Next when done.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.skillsMelee.title: Editing a Skill
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.skillsRest.conten: Fill out the rest of your skills the same way. Use this search box to find one quickly. Any values are fine — press Next to move on.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.skillsRest.title: The Rest of Your Skills
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.strikeModes.conte: Now that you're holding a weapon, its strike modes appear above. Click the highlighted ATK, BLK, and CX values to make those rolls — try them, then press Next.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.strikeModes.title: Strike Modes Appear
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.tinderbox.content: Now add a Tinderbox the same way (the Tinderbox is a Misc Gear subtype). Then close the item sheet. Next stays disabled until the Tinderbox exists.
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.tinderbox.title: Something to Carry
SOHL.Tour.CharCreation.title: SoHL: Create a Character
SOHL.Tour.Demo.description: A short walkthrough that demonstrates the SoHL guided-tour framework — free steps, sheet navigation, a value gate, and an action gate — using one of your Being actors.
SOHL.Tour.Demo.done.content: Free steps, sheet navigation, value gates, and action gates — the building blocks every SoHL tour is written from. Press the check to finish.
SOHL.Tour.Demo.done.title: That's the Framework
SOHL.Tour.Demo.intro.content: This quick tour shows what SoHL tours can do that a plain Foundry tour cannot: open a sheet, switch tabs, and hold Next until you've done something. Press Next to begin.
SOHL.Tour.Demo.intro.title: SoHL Guided Tours
SOHL.Tour.Demo.sheet.content: The tour opened one of your Being sheets and highlighted its name field. Steps can open any Actor or Item sheet and wait for it to render before pointing at something on it.
SOHL.Tour.Demo.sheet.title: Opening a Sheet
SOHL.Tour.Demo.stateGate.content: This is an action gate. Next stays disabled until you switch to the Combat tab yourself. Click the highlighted tab to continue — the tour waits for you, it doesn't click for you.

SOHL.Trauma.Fear.Note.Brave: Brave — immune to this source; +20 to Fear and Morale tests for five minutes.
SOHL.Trauma.Fear.Note.DefenseRestricted: May respond in combat only with Block or Dodge.
SOHL.Trauma.Fear.Note.Helpless: Catatonic — unaware, unable to act, and Helpless.
SOHL.Trauma.Fear.Note.Immune: Steady — immune to this source of fear.
SOHL.Trauma.Fear.Note.MustFlee: Must flee the source at full Move on the next turn.
SOHL.Trauma.Morale.NotShaken: Only a shaken (Withdrawing, Routed, or Catatonic) combatant makes this test.
SOHL.Trauma.Morale.Note.Brave: Brave — may act freely; +20 to Morale and Fear tests for five minutes.
SOHL.Trauma.Morale.Note.Helpless: Catatonic — unaware and unable to move, act, or defend.
SOHL.Trauma.Morale.Note.Routed: Routed — flees the source at full Move (or Passes and surrenders).
SOHL.Trauma.Morale.Note.Withdrawing: Withdrawing — retreats at half Move or more each turn.
SOHL.Trauma.Pall.Note.Catatonic: Catatonic — unaware and unable to move, act, or defend.
SOHL.Trauma.Pall.Note.Disturbed: Disturbed — must move out of the Pall.
SOHL.Trauma.Pall.Note.Resist: Resisted the Pall — immune to its sources for now.
SOHL.Trauma.Pall.Note.Terrified: Terrified — flees the source at full Move; no Counterstrike.
SOHL.Trauma.Rally.Unresponsive: Unresponsive — no allies rally; no further Rally Test for now.
SOHL.Trauma.Treatment.AlreadyHealed: This injury has already healed; no treatment is needed.
SOHL.Trauma.Treatment.NoPhysicianSkill: Your character has no Physician skill; the Treatment Test is not available.
SOHL.Trauma.Treatment.NotAnInjury: Only injuries can be treated with a Treatment Test.

SOHL.Welcome.intro: This system assists players and GMs playing Song of Heroic Lands (and other compatible systems) — it takes over the bookkeeping and mundane rolls and speeds up combat, while leaving every decision to you.
SOHL.Welcome.moreInfo: Head there for rules, guides, and everything else about the game. You can also read the User Guide journal entries bundled with the system — open the Compendium Packs sidebar and look in the Journals compendium.
SOHL.Welcome.speaker: Song of Heroic Lands
SOHL.Welcome.title: Welcome to Song of Heroic Lands
SOHL.Welcome.tours: New here? We highly recommend the guided tours — they walk you through the system right inside Foundry. Start the flagship Create a Character tour with the button below, or open any tour later from Settings → Tour Management (the Settings sidebar tab).
